name: 16a sliding window receptive field
title: Reach of a sliding window through layers
subtitle: 12 tokens; each layer lets a token read itself and the two tokens before it

steps.caption: Step 1. In layer 1, token 12 reads tokens 10, 11 and 12. The whole layer computes 33 pairs instead of the 78 that full causal attention would need.
Step 2. In layer 2, token 12 again reads positions 10 to 12, but token 10 already carries tokens 8 and 9 from layer 1, so token 12 now depends on tokens 8 to 12.
Step 3. Each further layer adds two positions: 6, then 4, then 2, and token 1 arrives after layer 6.
Step 4. With layer 2 switched to full causal attention, token 12 reads every layer-1 output directly, so token 1 reaches it after two layers instead of six.
Step 5. At real scale a window of 4,096 over 32 layers reaches about 131,000 positions on paper, while interleaved global layers reach the whole context within a few layers.
steps.heading: How far back the last token of a 131,072-token context can draw information, layer by layer
